escenes.text: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs who walked through the forest looking for a quiet place to build a house each. The first pig was cheerful but a bit lazy, the second was more hardworking, and the third was the most responsible and patient of all. They were all very excited to start their adventure.

When the time came to build their houses, the first little pig decided to make his out of straw because it was quick and easy. The second thought his should be made of wood, a little stronger and nicer. But the third, who wanted to be very safe, worked patiently and built his house with bricks, which was much stronger and sturdier.

The big bad wolf arrived at the little pig's straw house and knocked on the door.
'Little pig, little pig, let me come in!'
'No, no, not by the hair of my chinny chin chin!' answered the little pig bravely.
'Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house down!' shouted the wolf.
And he blew so hard that the straw house flew apart. The little pig ran as fast as he could to his brother's house.

The wolf ran to the wooden house and knocked at the door too.
'Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!'
'No, no, not by the hair of our chinny chin chins!' answered the two brothers together.
'Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house down!' growled the wolf, even angrier now.
And he blew so hard that the wooden house fell down too. The two little pigs, frightened, ran to their older brother's brick house.

When they got there, their big brother opened the door right away and let them in. Soon after, the wolf arrived too and knocked hard.
'Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!'
'No, no, not by the hair of our chinny chin chins — we'll never let you in!' answered the three pigs calmly.
'Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house down!' roared the wolf.
But no matter how hard he huffed and puffed, the brick house didn't budge an inch. The three little pigs burst out laughing, knowing they were safe inside their sturdy little house.

The wolf, furious that he couldn't get in, decided to climb onto the roof and come down through the chimney. But the older brother was very clever, and he quickly placed a big pot of boiling water under the fire.
When the wolf slid down the chimney... Splash! He landed headfirst in the hot pot and ran off, scalded and yelping, deep into the dark forest, never looking back.
From that day on, the three little pigs lived together in the brick house, happy and safe. And the wolf never bothered them again.
